owner: P-B — Invariant & Anti-Regression Guards (W346 prevention wave)
purpose: The machine-readable guard list P-A's verify-prevention harness consumes. Each entry names the historical fixture the guard must FIRE on and the clean control it must PASS on. A guard that no longer fires on its historical fixture is a MISS (exit 1) — the fixture/fix landed and the entry is stale, so it must be updated, never silently dropped.
testrunsRoot: resolved by each guard: the sibling ../testruns next to the repo, else <repo>/testruns

guards.title: Brief-driven minimum file set / under-production census
guards.seam: src/lib/codegen.server.ts deriveRequiredModules/minimumTreeFileCount (lane A A1); guard reads the tree's persisted .rapidtool/project.json
guards.proof: office-scheduler declares 5 spec-graph job nodes, 0 materialised (2-file tree) — the guard fires; bakery-florist-orders materialised all 5 — clean.

guards.title: Cross-chunk duplicate export / barrel collision
guards.seam: src/lib/codegen.server.ts materializeImportableTree/crossChunkDuplicateDeclarations + frozen export registry (lane A A2)
guards.proof: src/generated.ts re-exports getDailyRevenueByCategory, getTopSellingProducts, getTotalWaste, reconstructStockCount, transitionOrderStatus from BOTH remove-order-line.ts and get-daily-revenue-by.ts (TS2308); office-scheduler has no collision.

guards.title: Use-before-declaration (TDZ) in an emitted tree
guards.seam: src/lib/codegen.server.ts deterministic tree normalizer / store hoist (lane A A3)
guards.proof: mobile-companion/emitted/src/generated/suggest-reorder-quantity.ts line 69 reads 'globalThisStore' before its declaration at line 70 (TS2448); bakery-florist-orders has none.

guards.seam: src/lib/codegen.server.ts post-assembly money-semantics validator (lane A A5)
guards.proof: computeCartTotalPence promises 'cart total in integer pence' but accumulates quantity only (returns 4 for 3x2.50+1x4.00); office-invoice-tracker's formatPence reads its pence operand — clean.

guards.title: README 'What ships' vs disk parity
guards.proof: office-scheduler/emitted/README.md lists 5 src/jobs/*.ts that do not exist on disk; bakery-florist-orders and mobile-companion READMEs match disk.

guards.title: RUNLOCK / src-mtime mechanical preflight
guards.seam: run/RUNLOCK seam; operator runbook (lane B B5)
guards.historicalFixture: office-stock-tracker (BL-010 timestamp set: src edits 21:32:24-21:34:01 vs create 21:32:58)
guards.cleanControl: a window whose src mtimes all precede the run start, with the lock held
guards.proof: node scripts/guards/runlock-preflight.mjs --selftest refuses the BL-010 set (src/lib/websearch.server.ts 21:34:01 > run start 21:32:58) and the lock-absent case, and allows the clean window.

guards.title: Substance-based delivery gating (emit --git withholds an empty tree)
guards.seam: scripts/rapidtool-cli.mjs emit --git withhold cascade (lane B B1) + RT_E_SUBSTANCE_EMPTY in src/lib/errors.ts
guards.cleanControl: testruns/bakery-website/emitted.v2 (substance.real=5; the commit must still land)
guards.proof: delivery-gate.test.mjs spawns the real CLI on scratch copies: office-scheduler's empty tree is withheld with code RT_E_SUBSTANCE_EMPTY (ok:false, git.committed:false), and the real bakery-website v2 tree is never withheld as empty. B1 landed in scripts/rapidtool-cli.mjs:2299-2324.

guards.title: Monotonic repair + no-progress abort
guards.seam: src/lib/headless.ts driveP6Journey/repairTreeDir (lane B B2) consuming offenderClass/TreePlanCensus (lane A A6, I2)
guards.expectedCode: RT_E_REPAIR_FAILED (must become a monotonic sequence or a coded no-progress abort)
guards.cleanControl: an injected runTree sequence whose error count strictly decreases (accepted) vs a worse candidate (reverted)
guards.fixSeam: src/lib/headless.ts treeVerdictScore/failureSignature + driveP6Journey (lane D PR-07/PR-12) — the repeat-signature abort
guards.proof: repair-monotonic.test.mjs reads the real repair.json, ranks the real `BestTreeMetric {ok,ts,files}` via treeVerdictScore, and DRIVES the real driveP6Journey with injected deps that reproduce the same failure: it aborts on cycle 2 (budget 3) with the `no progress` event. The live-seam check (harness evaluateSeam C-04) asserts the comparator order and failureSignature stability/discrimination. PR-07/PR-12 landed in src/lib/headless.ts.

guards.title: Behavioural-spec guard that cannot be defeated by assert.fail in a skipped test
guards.expected: spec with only a shape probe returns false
guards.cleanControl: a spec whose live assertion ties a module read to a concrete value returns true
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs imports the real export and asserts false on the real office-invoice-tracker oracle bytes + true on a real assertion. B6 landed in src/lib/compile-check.server.ts.

guards.title: Classifier contract + negation/out-of-scope stripping
guards.expected: no real-estate/game/library for bakery/florist/mobile; out-of-scope text excluded
guards.historicalFixture: the seven testruns/*/brief.md; the orders brief's 'Explicitly out of scope' clause '- Multi-branch / multi-tenant support.'
guards.cleanControl: the seven briefs resolve to their corrected labels
guards.fixSeam: src/lib/engine.ts inferDomain/stripOutOfScope (lane C C2) — must exclude an out-of-scope/negation clause from classification while a genuine real-estate brief still classifies real-estate
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs asserts the corrected labels over the real briefs and that the real out-of-scope clause does not force real-estate. The live-seam check (harness evaluateSeam C-12) runs the REAL inferDomain on the clause (custom-software) and on a genuine real-estate brief (real-estate) as the mutation control. C2 landed in src/lib/engine.ts (stripOutOfScope).

guards.title: p6-arch fail-closed on an attempted keyed synthesis
guards.seam: src/lib/dod.ts p6-arch probe + archTrace/archProductComplete (lane C C8)
guards.expected: probe returns false for keyed attempt + absent tree
guards.historicalFixture: testruns/office-stock-tracker persisted project + the keyed-attempt sentinel (a p6.synthesis.* log)
guards.cleanControl: the keyless floor (no keyed attempt, absent tree) still passes
guards.fixSeam: src/lib/dod.ts DOD[6] p6-arch probe + archTrace/archProductComplete (lane C C8) — must return false when a keyed synthesis was attempted and no tree landed
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs calls the real DOD[6] p6-arch probe with a keyed-attempt + no-tree project and asserts false. The live-seam check (harness evaluateSeam C-14) runs the REAL probe on the sentinel (false) and on the keyless no-tree case (true) as the mutation control. C8 landed in src/lib/dod.ts.

guards.title: inferName markdown/truncation strip
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs calls the real inferName over the seven real briefs and asserts no leading '#' and no trailing em-dash. C3 landed in src/lib/engine.ts (inferName('bakery-website') === 'Golden Crust Bakery').

guards.title: Packet section guarantee (DoD + Research protected)
guards.expected: compiled packet contains '## Exit criteria (DoD)' and '## Research sources (live)'
guards.historicalFixture: testruns/office-invoice-tracker/build.json (and the other testruns packets, all truncated ~13.5k)
guards.cleanControl: a packet over budget keeps the protected sections
guards.fixSeam: src/lib/packet.ts truncateToBudget protectedBlocks (lane C C4) — must keep '## Exit criteria (DoD)' and '## Research sources (live)'
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs compiles the real project's packet via headless.packet and asserts both headings survive. The live-seam check (harness evaluateSeam C-18) compiles a genuinely over-budget packet (TRUNCATED marker) and asserts both protected sections survive; the truncation itself is the mutation control. C4 landed in src/lib/packet.ts.

guards.title: Deepen / approve honesty gate
guards.seam: src/lib/engine.ts deepenResearch (lane C C6) + store.approve vs unmet hard DoD (lane C C5)
guards.expected: an empty-corpus deepen throws the coded refusal and never re-records the gate; an approve never silently advances a gate with unmet hard criteria
guards.cleanControl: a deepen that lands findings returns the project; an approve with no unmet criteria is clean
guards.proof: gate-invariants.test.mjs replays approve1.json (approve over a 3-unmet gate) and calls the REAL deepenResearch on an empty corpus (throws RT_E_RESEARCH_UNAVAILABLE) with a findings-deepen mutation control. C6 landed in src/lib/engine.ts.
